subject.title: feat(chat): native session scroll-back with offset paging and import-aware history

question: Should native scroll-back land with oversized imported CLI snapshots remaining terminal until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/105644?
rationale: The branch intentionally exposes paging for local transcripts while deferring complete paging for byte-truncated imported transcripts, which is a user-visible protocol and scope choice rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Accept the scoped boundary
options.body: Fix the first-page consumer defect, obtain real-session proof, and land while retaining the linked cursor issue for oversized imports.

options.title: Require complete import paging
options.body: Hold this PR until an opaque snapshot cursor makes byte-truncated imported history fully pageable.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped boundary
recommendation.body: Fix the first-page consumer defect, obtain real-session proof, and land while retaining the linked cursor issue for oversized imports.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent scroll-back implementation and authored the linked native and snapshot-cursor directions.
